hooks.command: input=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$input" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo ''); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'rm -rf|git push --force|git push -f|dd if=|mkfs|chmod -R 777|curl.*\| *sh|wget.*\| *sh|> /dev/sd'; then echo "BLOCKED: Dangerous command detected: $cmd" >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

input=$(cat); file=$(echo "$input" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo ''); if [ -n "$file" ]; then echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] CHANGED: $file" >> "$(git -C "$(dirname "$file")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/.claude/change.log" 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0

branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown'); staged=$(git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); echo "=== TaskLens Dev Session ==="; echo "Branch : $branch"; echo "Staged : $staged file(s)"; exit 0
